answer: Minting-cost proof-of-work resists sybils: each new identity must burn real CPU to mine its key, never handed free from the harbor. One honest account pays once; a swarm of a thousand fakes pays a thousand separate computations down the canyon. The key is earned, not draped on like velvet, so the toll climbs with head count and cheap mass registration stalls against compounding compute no shortcut can fake away.
